The first public release of **hma-mcp**: an MCP server that lets Claude (or any MCP client) read and edit GBA Pokémon ROMs through [HexManiacAdvance](https://github.com/haven1433/HexManiacAdvance)'s engine.

**Bring your own ROM.** hma-mcp doesn't include or download any.

### Download

| You use | Get |
|---|---|
| Claude Desktop | `hma-mcp-win32.mcpb`, `hma-mcp-darwin.mcpb` (Apple Silicon) or `hma-mcp-linux.mcpb`, then double-click it |
| Claude Code, other clients | `hma-mcp-<system>.zip` / `.tar.gz`; unpack and point your client at `hma-mcp` ([setup](https://github.com/dewayneku/hma-mcp#quick-start)) |

The builds are self-contained, so you don't need .NET. On macOS, run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine <folder>` on a downloaded build before starting it.

### What it can do

- **Tables:** stats, moves, items, trainers, learnsets, TM/HM lists, evolutions and wild encounters, read and written by name (`CHARMANDER`, `THUNDERBOLT`). Out-of-range values and typos are rejected instead of written.
- **Maps:** find a map by name, then list its NPCs, warps, signs, trigger scripts and connections.
- **Scripts:** decompile and compile event, battle, animation and AI scripts. A script that grows is moved to free space and every pointer to it is updated.
- **Text:** read and write game text. Longer text is moved and repointed.
- **Safety:** nothing touches the file until `save`, the first save backs up your ROM, and every tool call is one undo step. Saves write HMA's `.toml`, so the HMA editor opens them as usual.

### Tested on

- **FireRed (U) 1.0:** full test suite.
- **Emerald (U):** a shorter check of tables, maps, scripts, text and save.

Ruby, Sapphire and LeafGreen use the same engine but haven't been tested yet. [Game test reports](https://github.com/dewayneku/hma-mcp/issues/new/choose) are welcome.

Known gaps (graphics, adding new map events, one ROM at a time) are listed in [docs/limitations.md](https://github.com/dewayneku/hma-mcp/blob/main/docs/limitations.md).
